reference.name: CI Reference
reference.whyRelevant: Exercises Forge's mandatory external-reference intelligence path.
reference.problemSolved: Demonstrates a reference-driven project without allowing surface imitation.

composition: Primary subject dominates while interface copy occupies a protected negative-space region.
typography: Display typography remains subordinate to the subject during the main reveal.
depth: Foreground and background layers create depth without requiring every element to move.
scrollChoreography: Scroll progression is paced as discrete reveals rather than constant equal-intensity animation.
transitionMechanics: Major transitions preserve one visual anchor so the experience reads as continuous.
persistentAnchors: A persistent subject carries continuity across chapters.
domWebglResponsibilities: Semantic copy remains independent from visual rendering responsibilities.
signatureMoment: The strongest moment changes the visitor's understanding of the subject rather than merely increasing effect intensity.
mobileTranslation: Mobile preserves narrative order and the signature reveal while reducing simultaneous spatial complexity.
performanceRisks: The persistent visual subject should be prewarmed before the signature reveal.

hypotheses: Exact implementation libraries are intentionally not inferred from appearance.

transferableLessons.lesson: Carry one meaningful subject across chapters so transitions feel causal rather than decorative.
transferableLessons.causalReason: Continuity works because the visitor can track one stable narrative object while the surrounding presentation changes.

transferableLessons.lesson: Reserve the largest visual transformation for a single signature beat.
transferableLessons.causalReason: Contrast between restrained chapters and one decisive reveal makes the peak feel intentional.

noNewDependency: No dependency should be added solely because the reference appears to use it.
